drivers.detail: Marketplace entities with >49% foreign ownership cannot hold inventory. Swiggy foreign holding 49.76% (6 Jul 2026); board approved 49.5% cap, shareholders approved 18 Aug 2026 (99.9%+; a May Articles amendment failed at ~72% vs 75% needed). IOCC certification not yet confirmed; broker estimate no earlier than Mar-2027, inventory shift Apr-2027 at earliest (Swiggy's own plan says mid-Q3FY27, so timing conflict). Blinkit already converted. Mgmt claims ~80bps contribution gain, 8-10 days shorter working capital.

AICPDF (distributors federation) complaint referred by DPIIT to CCI in Sep 2024 alleging below-cost sales by Blinkit, Instamart, Zepto; CCI said preliminary review, DG probe only if prima facie case. No formal order found.

Code on Social Security s.114(4): aggregators contribute 1-2% of annual turnover, capped at 5% of payments to gig workers. Rate/start date reported as awaiting notification as of 18 Oct 2026 (one source says codes enforced). No company cost estimate found.

Karnataka Act 2025: 1% levy on food/grocery deliveries; HC declined stay 3 Jul 2026 but ordered deposit of disputed fee with registry; platforms argue overlap with central Code; next hearing 14 Aug. Rajasthan Act 2023 creates welfare board/fund; rate not found.

DGGI Pune notices to Swiggy and Zomato on delivery charges July 2017-Mar 2023 (18% GST); Swiggy ~Rs350-402 cr per differing reports; companies argue pass-through to riders below Rs20 lakh threshold. 2026 status not found.
No quantified FY26 ad income or platform-fee share found in this pass.
Eternal adding Blinkit stores (308 in Q2; 3,500+ by Mar-2027, ~5,000 by Mar-2028), Zepto IPO-cleared, Flipkart Minutes and Amazon Now expanding.
